methodology: Visual inspection of all content-flagged samples (23 unique images) + 12 stratified passing samples

passing_sample_validation.notes: All 12 passing samples confirmed correct across all fields. 100% accuracy.

has_table.root_cause: Docling layout extractor consistently misdetects multi-column horizontal text layouts as 'Table' class. All 10 flagged samples are multi-column text with no actual tables.
has_table.universal_risk: HIGH - Docling Table detection unreliable on synthetic multi-column documents. All JSSODa datasets using Docling layout may have same issue.

has_formula.root_cause: LLM partially detects formulas but also flags chemistry/science discussion text without rendered formulas. 2 samples have genuine mathematical expressions.

has_figure.root_cause: Docling layout extractor misdetects dense text blocks or dark rendering artifacts as 'Picture' class. No actual figures/images present in any flagged sample.
has_figure.universal_risk: MEDIUM - Docling Picture detection unreliable on dense synthetic text. Check other synthetic datasets.

samples_inspected.reason: Text with math expressions, no actual figure/picture
All text about Kokura city, no figure/picture
Dense vertical text with dark rendering, no figure/picture

has_handwriting.root_cause: LLM cannot reliably detect handwriting on synthetic images. All 4 flagged samples contain only typed/rendered text. In one case (horizontal_00934), the word 'handwriting' (手書き) appears in the text content, likely confusing the LLM.
has_handwriting.universal_risk: HIGH - LLM handwriting detection unreliable on synthetic datasets. Manual override needed for all synthetic datasets.

samples_inspected.reason: All typed text, no handwriting present
All typed text, no handwriting present
All typed text. Word 'handwriting' in text content likely confused LLM
All typed text, no handwriting present

domain_level1_unk_assessment.assessment: UNK classification is understandable for generic/literary/narrative Japanese text that doesn't fit clean domain categories (ADM, EDU, SCI, etc.). These are typically personal narratives, cultural essays, or creative writing. Reclassification to PER (personal) would be reasonable but requires per-sample review. Accepted as-is for now.
domain_level1_unk_assessment.prescreening_impact: UNK causes domain_level1 prescreening failure. This is a known limitation of LLM domain classification on synthetic creative content.

summary.net_impact: 21 false positive content flags corrected. Remaining true positives: 2 has_formula only.
